Keep all four columns when the inspector is closed and retain the existing mobile column removal.
Run Svelte diagnostics and recapture the inspector state after the correction.
reasoning: Fresh 18746 capture at the available desktop viewport showed the intended list-detail composition and a concrete responsive table defect. The next edit is limited to that collision and preservation of its information in the inspector.
